user.title: Room Advisor
user.description:
Room Advisor tells you what is worth doing in each room, and why, as entities your automations can use.

This hub holds the inputs and default settings that every room inherits, so you only set them once. Everything here is optional, and any room can override what it inherits.

Add your rooms next.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. There is one Room Advisor hub per house; add each room to the existing hub.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Pick the area this room covers. Room Advisor reads the entities already assigned to that area, so there is nothing else to wire up.

data_description.area_id: Each area can be added once. The room takes its name from the area.

reconfigure.title: Move room to another area
reconfigure.description: Point this room at a different area. Its advice keeps the same entity IDs, so anything already using them keeps working.

data_description.area_id: Each area can be added once.

abort.already_configured: That area is already set up as a room.
